    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

# PyChrono Gator Vehicle Simulation with Irrlicht Visualization

Here's a complete PyChrono simulation script for a Gator vehicle on flat terrain with interactive controls:

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.gator as gator
import pychrono.vehicle.terrain as terrain
import numpy as np

# ==============================================================================
# Simulation parameters
# ==============================================================================

# Simulation step size
step_size = 0.01  # 10 ms

# Simulation end time
t_end = 100.0

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # 50 FPS

# ==============================================================================
# Create the simulation system and add items
# ==============================================================================

# Create the Chrono physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

# Create the vehicle system
vehicle = gator.Gator()
vehicle.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordinator(0, 0, 0.5))
vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(10)
vehicle.Initialize(system)

# Set up the terrain
terrain_length = 100.0
terrain_width = 100.0
terrain = terrain.RigidTerrain(system)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVectorD(terrain_length, terrain_width, 0))
patch.SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("textures/concrete.jpg"), 20, 20)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))
terrain.Initialize()

# ==============================================================================
# Visualization system
# ==============================================================================

# Create the Irrlicht application
vis = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, "Gator Vehicle Simulation", chrono.irr.dimension2du(1280, 720))
vis.AddTypicalLogo()
vis.AddTypicalSky()
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddTypicalCamera(chrono.irr.core.vector3df(10, 0, 3))
vis.AssetBindAll()
vis.AssetUpdateAll()

# Enable mesh visualization for all vehicle components
vehicle.GetChassisBody().SetCollide(False)
vehicle.GetChassisBody().SetVisualize(True)
vehicle.GetChassisBody().GetVisualModel().SetSmoothFaces(True)

for axle in vehicle.GetAxles():
    for wheel in axle.GetWheels():
        wheel.SetVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
        wheel.GetVisualizationModel().SetSmoothFaces(True)

# ==============================================================================
# Interactive driver system
# ==============================================================================

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis.GetDevice())
vehicle.SetDriver(driver)
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

# ==============================================================================
# Simulation loop
# ==============================================================================

# Number of simulation steps between two 3D view render frames
render_steps = int(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    # Collect driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update the state of the vehicle
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)

    # Update the vehicle system
    vehicle.Update(step_size)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.DoStepDynamics(step_size)
    vis.EndScene()

    # Update counters
    time = vehicle.GetChTime()
    frame += 1

    # Exit simulation if time limit reached
    if time > t_end:
        break

print("Simulation completed.")
```

patch1.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/grass.jpg"), 20, 20)
patch1.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.2, 0.8, 0.2))
patch1.SetHeightMap(height_map)

# Add second patch with a bump (using a simple height function)
patch2 = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat,

    50, 50)
patch2.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/dirt.jpg"), 20, 20)
patch2.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.6, 0.4, 0.2))
# Create a bump in the center of the patch
patch2.SetHeightFunction(veh.HeightFunction("0.5 * exp(-(x*x + y*y)/10)", -25, 25, -25, 25))

# -------------------------------------
# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface
# Create the driver system
# -------------------------------------

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('Gator vehicle with multi-texture terrain')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# Output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
